items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I loved that company and Mr. Koenig was such a wonderful man.

ctx.x: Yeah. And you know he hadn't made any jazz records because he was always symphony. And he was terrific. And what part that made me feel so good was when I got ready to make my other session Mr. Koenig would call me and he said, "Helen, I want to ask something". I said, "what?" He said, "well, Andre Previn told me to ask you, could he be on the next session". I said, "are you kidding?" I was just so happy that he was on there and I wouldn't have had the nerve to ask him.
